overview: This file documents Japan’s cotton industry from 1932 to 1939 through consular correspondence, a 1936 illustrated statistical history, and a detailed 1939 Osaka report. It covers raw cotton imports, spinning and weaving, artificial cotton and staple fiber experiments, industrial controls, textile exports, prices, and the possible effects of war in Europe.
interest: Its illustrated 1910–35 statistics and 1939 forecast connect long-term industry growth with wartime supply concerns.
